scripts.dev:all: pnpm build:packages && pnpm exec convex dev --once && pnpm dev
scripts.dev:watch: pnpm build:packages && concurrently -n convex,vite -c blue,green "pnpm exec convex dev" "pnpm dev"
scripts.build: pnpm build:packages && vite build && node scripts/strip-sourcemaps.mjs && node scripts/generate-sw.mjs
scripts.build:development: pnpm build:packages && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=dev vite build --mode development && node scripts/strip-sourcemaps.mjs && node scripts/generate-sw.mjs
scripts.seed:test: sh -c 'pnpm exec convex run seed:seedTestData "{\"userId\":\"${1:?pass the Clerk user id}\"}"' seed
scripts.seed:clear: sh -c 'pnpm exec convex run seed:clearUserData "{\"userId\":\"${1:?pass the Clerk user id}\"}"' seed
scripts.deploy:dev: node scripts/env.mjs exec dev --only github -- sh -c 'pnpm build:packages && pnpm exec convex dev --once && pnpm build:development && pnpm exec wrangler deploy'
scripts.deploy:production: node scripts/env.mjs exec production --only github -- sh -c 'pnpm build:packages && pnpm exec convex deploy && pnpm build && pnpm exec wrangler deploy'
scripts.mobile:update:preview: node scripts/env.mjs exec staging --only eas -- node apps/mobile/scripts/publish-update.mjs preview
scripts.mobile:update:production: node scripts/env.mjs exec production --only eas -- node apps/mobile/scripts/publish-update.mjs production
